hero_heading: SEO Services That Help Your Business Get Found.
hero_text: I help businesses improve their visibility in search results with practical, well-planned SEO — from audits and strategy to ongoing optimization and reporting.

sections.label: Why It Matters
sections.heading: Why SEO Is Important for Your Business
sections.subheading: Because Customers Start Their Search Online.
sections.text: When people look for the products or services you offer, they search first. SEO helps your business show up at that moment, with the right message, in front of the right audience.

sections.label: What I Offer
sections.heading: SEO Services
sections.text: From audits to ongoing optimization, I provide practical SEO support to help your business improve its search visibility.

sections.heading: AEO, GEO & LLMO
sections.subheading: SEO for the Way People Search Today.
sections.text: More people now get answers from AI tools and answer engines. I help your content and brand stay visible there, alongside traditional search.

sections.label: Why Work With Me
sections.heading: Why SEO With Me
sections.text: SEO is not a checklist. Keyword research, backlinks and blog writing only create value when they are part of a plan. Done in isolation, they can look like progress without moving your business forward.

sections.heading: Ready to Improve Your Search Visibility?
sections.text: Let’s discuss your business goals and explore how a tailored SEO strategy can support them.

faqs.question: What SEO services do you offer?
faqs.answer: I offer SEO audits and strategy, keyword research, on-page SEO, technical SEO, content SEO, strategic blog creation, link building, Local SEO, E-commerce SEO, and AI search optimization (AEO, GEO and LLMO).

faqs.question: Can you guarantee my business will appear in AI answers?
faqs.answer: No. AI platforms don’t publish how they choose their sources. I focus on clear, credible, well-structured content and a consistent brand presence that gives you the best foundation.

faqs.question: Do you guarantee rankings?
faqs.answer: No one can honestly guarantee specific rankings. I focus on ethical, white-hat practices, transparent communication, and steady improvement in your search presence.

faqs.question: Do you work on WordPress and Wix websites?
faqs.answer: Yes, WordPress and Wix are two of the platforms I work with regularly.

faqs.question: Can you help a business that serves a specific local area?
faqs.answer: Yes. Local SEO, including Google Business Profile optimization, is one of the services I offer.

faqs.question: How do I get started?
faqs.answer: You can get in touch through my contact form, email, or WhatsApp. We can discuss your requirements and explore the right approach for your business.
